about: The user's own pencil, ink and coloured-pencil drawings (Steve the normal's sketchbook), photographed on paper. Kept for their technique: line weight, directional shading, pose, energy marks, humour. Most are fan art of other people's characters: agents study how they are drawn and never reproduce the characters. These are not public domain or CC0, so they live here, apart from the masterworks index.
rules: Learn the technique, never redraw the character.
Do not ship these pictures, or copies of them, in an app, game or video.

pictures.title: Squashed yellow face
pictures.author: Steve the normal (the user)
pictures.licence: the user's own drawing; all rights reserved
pictures.technique: A bold grey contour round a squashed face, yellow coloured pencil laid in loose directed strokes, the dark features scribbled in densely. The outline does the drawing; the colour stays loose inside it.

pictures.title: The face door
pictures.author: Steve the normal (the user)
pictures.licence: the user's own drawing; all rights reserved
pictures.note: The user's own original drawing. (the face may be a known cartoon character's; if so, treat it as fan art.)
pictures.technique: Speckled stucco texture against flat door panels; the darkest dark (the mask) right next to the whitest white (the eyes) is the focal point. Panel frames shaded so they read as recessed.

pictures.title: Upward profile
pictures.author: Steve the normal (the user)
pictures.licence: the user's own drawing; all rights reserved
pictures.note: Fan art: the character belongs to its owners. Study the technique; never redraw the character.
pictures.technique: Chin up, the whole figure leans back: attitude from one tilt. Hair spikes shaded along their length, muscles shaded as one block on the side away from the light, clean contour on top.

pictures.technique: A crouch with the fist pushed at the viewer (foreshortening), gritted teeth, cloth folds hatched along the pull of the fabric, radiating marks round the glowing ball.
